aboutSubheading: Local, reliable & dedicated to your garden
aboutText: Based in St Albans, AE Mowing is dedicated to transforming outdoor spaces across Melbourne's western suburbs. We deliver reliable, affordable, and high-quality gardening and landscaping services tailored to your needs. Whether you need regular mowing or a complete garden makeover, our team keeps your lawn healthy and beautiful all year round. We recognise every customer's unique requirements and customise our offerings to deliver outstanding results.
servicesText: AE Mowing provides a full range of gardening and landscaping services for St Albans homes and businesses. From initial consultations to ongoing lawn care, our experienced team customises every plan to suit your outdoor space, keeping it lush, neat, and healthy throughout every season.

services.title: Initial Consultation
services.desc: We assess your garden's current condition and discuss your vision, creating a tailored plan that suits your space and budget.

services.title: Custom Mowing Plans
services.desc: Every garden is unique. We design bespoke mowing schedules matched to your lawn type, garden size, and lifestyle needs.

services.title: Expert Mowing Service
services.desc: Our skilled team delivers precise, professional mowing to keep your lawn neat, healthy, and looking its best week after week.

services.title: Ongoing Care & Adjustments
services.desc: We monitor your garden's progress and adjust our care plans as needed, ensuring lasting results through every season.

services.title: Garden Landscaping
services.desc: Transform your outdoor area with our landscaping services, from garden beds and planting to complete backyard makeovers.

services.title: Lawn Maintenance
services.desc: Regular fertilising, weed control, and edging to maintain a lush, green lawn that you can be proud of all year.
